_comment: Type-check EVERY target's components. They compile inside a CONSUMER
project, never as part of anything in this directory, so a missing import
or a renamed export is invisible without this and fatal there — it breaks
every generated SDK of that language.
This is the same gate `check-scaffold` is for the bundled scaffold. It is
the FIRST thing a migrated target loses and the first it has to get back:
sdkgen's build no longer sees this tree at all.
fragment/ is excluded: fragments are template source carrying placeholder
